text:
maria: fyi onboarding orpheus-7b-int4 into longprefill suite. observed divergence vs fp16 around ~12.1k tokens: repeated fragments and small grammar shifts. adding debug output. :thinking_face:
jamie: can you paste exact repro flags / quant params?
sasha: per-channel or per-tensor quant? symmetric? clipping?
maria: per-channel symmetric, clip=0.015, rotary_rescale enabled (default). runtime: kv-shard=auto. input is concatenated legal docs ~14k tokens. excerpt:
```
... token_pos ~12112
L9: kv_index_expected=12112 kv_index_actual=12111
L10: kv_index_expected=12112 kv_index_actual=12111
ERROR: kv_cache_alignment_mismatch at step 12112
Divergence at token 12114: fp16-> "the agreement was" | int4-> "there agreement were"
```
ting: multiple layers show off-by-one write index. smells like packing order nondeterminism when rotary rescale triggers split path in int4 kernel. did you see warmstart phase drift?
maria: yes small phase deltas reported during warmstart.
sasha: try forcing rotary_rescale=false and rerun a 13k warmprefill. that will isolate whether rescale interpolation is the catalyst.
jamie: launching quick run with rotary_rescale=false + quant_clip=0.02. cmd:
./runtest --model orpheus-7b-int4 --suite longprefill --max-tokens 14000 --rotary_rescale=false --quant_clip 0.02 --log-level debug
jamie: initial: no kv_index mismatches up to 13k; alignment with fp16 looks good in early window. full job running.
maria: please dump per-layer kvcache checksums every 1k so we can diff.
jamie: added checksums. sample:
ksum_fp16_L9@12000=0x9a3f12b4
ksum_int4_L9@12000=0x9a3f12b4
ksum_fp16_L9@12112=0x8b12ff00
ksum_int4_L9@12112=0x8b12feff  # off by 1
sasha: that off-by-one in checksum matches write-pointer ordering difference. hypothesis: fused_kv_pack for int4 performs early commit for partial blocks when rotary_rescale path toggles, changing write sequence.
ting: mitigation options: force non-fused pack (slower CPU) or pad kvcache allocations to align pack block size (e.g., pad to 512-token boundaries). which is lower risk?
jamie: padding to 512 adds ~3% memory but stable; non-fused pack increases CPU and affects latency. padded runs recovered alignment through full 14k.
maria: created incident inc-2026-0422 for tracking. triage-bot: created inc-2026-0422: "orpheus-7b-int4 kvpack ordering hysteresis on longprefill"
triage-bot: severity S3, owner eng-ml-oncall
sasha: I'll write a microbench to exercise fused_kv_pack ordering under rotary_rescale toggles and int4 rounding modes; will try to produce a minimal repro (short repeated segment that reproduces after a few cycles).
jamie: also tried per-tensor quant: diverged earlier (~9k), per-channel is better but still susceptible when rescale=true. note for onboarding.
ting: concrete actions:
- add 14k longprefill regression in onboarding pipeline for any int4 model (owner: maria)
- unit test for fused_kv_pack ordering invariants under rotary_rescale (owner: sasha)
- temporarily set default rotary_rescale=false for int4 on Dedicated/staging (ops: jamie)
- add CI job with kvcache padding=512 to catch regressions (devex)
maria: I'll draft PRs and update onboarding checklist to run per-channel and per-tensor variants.
jamie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4021 includes kvcache-checksum artifact and job config.
sasha: will attach microbench + minimal repro case to the PR.
maria: tl;dr: root cause likely interaction between fused int4 packing order and rotary_rescale interpolation causing nondeterministic write ordering; mitigation = padding or disabling rescale until kernel fix + add regression tests. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: scheduled config change (rotary_rescale=false for int4) to roll out to staging 2026-04-23T03:00:00Z; prod tentative 2026-04-24T03:00:00Z after postmortem.
jamie: can someone add short onboarding playbook note? I updated PR description but need docs edit.
maria: will update playbook. thanks everyone.
